query:
-- 查询 jiang 用户的联系人总数
SELECT COUNT(*) as totalContacts FROM contacts WHERE parentUserId = 29;

-- 查询本周新增（假设今天是2026-01-22）
SELECT COUNT(*) as newThisWeek 
FROM contacts 
WHERE parentUserId = 29 
  AND createdAt >= '2026-01-20 00:00:00';

-- 查询本月新增
SELECT COUNT(*) as newThisMonth 
FROM contacts 
WHERE parentUserId = 29 
  AND createdAt >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00';

-- 查询今年新增
SELECT COUNT(*) as newThisYear 
FROM contacts 
WHERE parentUserId = 29 
  AND createdAt >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00';
